connector.name: GammaRips Options Intelligence
connector.registryDescription: Anti-firehose options-flow data for AI agents: curated daily pool, features, realized outcomes.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.gammarips.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the devdizzle account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: GammaRips API key (gr_live_...) sent as a Bearer token. Optional: 5 free-tier tools work without it; the 4 pro tools require an active subscription from https://gammarips.com/pricing.
